_about: Single source for prompt language. tools/airpg_render.py --plan builds every request from these blocks; docs/visual-design-system.md sections 3 and 8 describe them. Change a block here, never inside a request file. One AI look only: the System AI. There is no Narrator style.

blocks.card: Cinematic dark-fantasy character card illustration, square, single subject centered with generous margin, waist-up or full body, high contrast, sharp detail, obsidian black and slate grey background with deep Puget Sound teal and sea-glass green, neon magenta-violet System rim light, warm sodium-orange accent light, rainy Pacific Northwest atmosphere, darker edges. Friendly, funny, game-show energy, never menacing, no weapons. Subject:
blocks.floor: Cinematic dark-fantasy digital illustration, wide 16:9 environment scene, no people, no faces, no text, high contrast, obsidian and slate background with deep Puget Sound teal, magenta-violet System glow accents, warm sodium-orange practical lights, rainy Pacific Northwest atmosphere, darker edges. Subject:
blocks.icon: Dark fantasy game interface icon, a single object centered with generous empty margin, cinematic lighting, high contrast, polished brass and weathered leather detail, plain obsidian black background (#0B0E14), soft glow halo. Subject:

endings.card: A blank glowing violet interface frame edge at the card border, with no writing. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no watermark, no signature.
endings.floor: No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no watermark, no signature.
endings.icon: No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no user interface.

model_sheet.CORDULA: Cordula Vance, a Marine Corps Reserve crew chief in her late twenties with dark curly hair, an orange and black high-visibility drysuit and a tactical float vest, holding a black touring kayak paddle, no weapons
model_sheet.BARNABY: Barnaby, a wild Giant Pacific Octopus bigger than any on record, about 22 feet arm tip to arm tip, reddish-orange skin with crimson and white flashes, old scars and barnacle-worn suckers of a wild animal from the Tacoma Narrows, a polished brass collar around his mantle, no human face, not a monster
model_sheet.GEODUCK: a real Puget Sound geoduck clam: a small pale oblong shell no bigger than a hand, and growing out of it a huge, long, thick, wrinkled tan siphon neck, two feet long and far bigger than the shell, the shell has no face, no eyes, no legs, no arms
model_sheet.LUMPSUCKER: a tiny round green Pacific spiny lumpsucker fish, perfectly round like a golf ball, covered in bumpy tubercles, big black glaring eyes, stubby tiny fins, no long body, no tail stalk, not a seahorse
model_sheet.BARNABY_PACK: Barnaby, a huge wild Giant Pacific Octopus with crimson and white flashes and a polished brass collar, riding in a clear backpack water tank that is bigger on the inside, arms spilling over the rim, no human face
model_sheet.CADABRA_DRONE: a cheerful boxy cardboard-brown delivery drone with four rotors and a dangling parcel claw, a plain brass-rimmed parcel badge, no letters, no logo, not a real brand
